Abstract.AbstractText: The first molybdovanadate cluster with a polyarylimido trimetal fragment, [V4Mo3O14(NAr)3(μ2-NAr)3]2-, was in situ synthesized by using (TBA)3[H3V10O28] as proton and vanadium sources. Additional aniline hydrochlorides will give rise to the formation of phenyl guanidines, which will serve as cations and proton donors to form chain-like and dimeric supermolecules via H-bonding.
